defect.summary: The `mpd-better-sidebar` mount guard derived the profile directory from `baseUrl` with a POSIX-shaped expression, so clause 1 answered "not resolvable" on EVERY win32 profile and the bundle's only sidebar mount was disabled even when dsh-better-sidebar WAS resolvable in the profile.
defect.symbol: row `mpd-better-sidebar`, `disabled: !!js` mount guard, clause 1 (`dsh-better-sidebar is not resolvable from the profile node_modules`)

hash_sandwich.note: the pre-fix bytes were restored for the red mount arm and the fixed bytes re-applied byte-identically between the two readings

mechanism: win32 `path.normalize` reads the leading `/` as the CURRENT drive root: the value becomes `\C:\Users\<u>\.dsh\profiles\web\`.

`fs.existsSync(path.join(that, 'node_modules', 'dsh-better-sidebar'))` therefore answers false while `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-better-sidebar` really exists (measured: real path true, mangled path false).
clause 1 returns true (DISABLED) with the reason "dsh-better-sidebar is not resolvable from the profile node_modules".
When `baseUrl` is a plain path instead of a file URL the same guard throws `Invalid URL` and the outer catch returns DISABLED as well, so both branches were disabled-only on win32.
defect.class: Same doubled-drive-prefix class the win32 wave (commit 010d9ef6) fixed for the presets row and the four MCP rows of this SAME file, and documents in the file's FILE-URL header (lines 13-21). The guard was the one spot left on the POSIX-shaped form, and it had no test.

reproduction.method: Extracts the SHIPPED `disabled: !!js` scalar from cordis.patch.yml (never a re-typed copy), evaluates it with `new Function` against synthetic profile layouts in a temp sandbox, with DSH_HOME pointed at that sandbox and the guard's own console.warn decision captured.

red_before_fix.key_observation: the fixture profile DOES contain node_modules/dsh-better-sidebar and the guard still reported `DISABLED - dsh-better-sidebar is not resolvable from the profile node_modules`

mount_pair.method: Real isolated dsh boot of the bundle's OWN web profile (bundles: dsh-base, dsh-web-app, @mpd-dsh/mpd; link dependency on this checkout; sandbox DSH_HOME + sandbox HOME; server stdio to a FILE) on win32; the guard's decision is read out of the boot log. Probe: raw/mount-probe.mjs (evidence artifact, not shipped code).

before_fix.guardLine: [mpd-better-sidebar] mount guard: DISABLED - dsh-better-sidebar is not resolvable from the profile node_modules

after_fix.guardLine: [mpd-better-sidebar] mount guard: ENABLED - web plane present and no other layer mounts dsh-better-sidebar

mount_pair.reading: Everything but the guard bytes is constant across the pair. Pre-fix the bundle's declared sidebar host was never mounted on win32 (no sidebar, hence no AgentTeams/Workmates tabs); post-fix the row mounts it.

known_limits.measured: [bundle-lifecycle] FAIL: install step failed: no dsh launcher on PATH
known_limits.cause: `skills/dsh-qa/scripts/lib/dsh-launcher.mjs#resolveOnPath` reads `env.PATH` on a PLAIN `{...process.env}` copy (built by `credentialEnv`), but win32 enumerates that variable as `Path`, so `env.PATH` is undefined and no PATH directory is scanned. `dsh.cmd` sits in C:\Users\zhao.yinan\AppData\Roaming\npm and resolves correctly when the real `process.env` proxy is used (verified), so this is a case-sensitivity defect of the lane, not a missing install.
known_limits.scope: skills/** — deliberately NOT fixed in this commit (out of scope for the guard defect; skills edits carry the single-writer rule and a VENDOR_LOCK re-pin, AGENTS.md §9).

known_limits.item: the MOUNT gate was therefore measured with an evidence-local probe
known_limits.note: raw/mount-probe.mjs boots the same profile through the harness entry directly (process.execPath + <harness>/lib/bin.js), so no PATH lookup is involved. It is an evidence artifact and is not part of the shipped tree.

symptom_it_explains.reported: "本机有 better-sidebar 的时候装上去插件照样认不出来"
symptom_it_explains.reading: Two independent causes. (1) On win32 the guard disabled the bundle's own sidebar mount unconditionally, so a profile without a foreign (unguarded) sidebar mount had no sidebar at all. (2) On THIS machine the GUI's profile (`web`) never declared @mpd-dsh/mpd as a layer — only a stray, pnpm-unknown junction sat in its node_modules — so the mpd rows never composed: measured GET /sidebar/api -> 405 (the host IS up, via the @linxin666/dsh-web-all aggregate) while GET /plugins/mpd-workmate/list -> 404 (the mpd bundle is not loaded). Cause (1) is fixed here; cause (2) is an install action.
